executive_summary: Comprehensive independent technical and code review of the 2026-10-03 frontend refactor and automated market data collector. All 9 subject files match freeze-manifest.json SHA-256 digests and byte counts exactly. The test suites pass unconditionally (full pytest: 92 passed, 4 skipped; node test suite: 19 passed; pinned render truthfulness with candidate.json under headless Google Chrome: 9 passed, 0 failed). Scope verification confirms clean separation between code and data releases, with all four product renderers bound to frontend_contract.json. Deep code inspection confirms that all hardcoded August/September static fallback corpses across fed-boc-watcher DOM elements (brief grid, odds cards, summary cards, market check strip, calendar table) have been eliminated in favor of neutral loading states and dynamic top-driver rendering. Polymarket and verdict block mount anchors are validated across all pricing states. Layout optimizations in economic-calendar (FlagCDN w20/w40 sizing with text fallback, 3-column chart grid, Chart.js padding) and dynamic y-axis scaling in canadian-banks and ai-software successfully prevent visual clipping. The automated market collector (scripts/econ/fetch_fed_boc_market.py) strictly adheres to the 2-decimal arithmetic contract, 5-session week-over-week base lookups, implied monthly rate calculations, and safe atomic writes.
